title: Classic Brooklyn Egg Cream with Shaken Milk Foam
summary: A classic cold drink made from cold milk and soda water shaken until foamy, topped with chocolate syrup and a thick foam head.
equipment: cocktail shaker or jar with lid

steps.title: Shake
steps.text: Put 60 ml very cold whole milk and about 2 tbsp of the soda water in a cocktail shaker or jar with 1 ice cube, close and shake hard 15–20 s until frothy.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Top up with the remaining soda water, pouring into the centre so a thick white foam rises to the rim.

steps.title: Drizzle
steps.text: Drizzle 2½ tbsp chocolate syrup through the foam so it sinks to the bottom, leaving a white head over a dark base.

steps.title: Drink
steps.text: Stir gently only in the lower part if you want it mixed, keeping the foam intact, and drink immediately.

tips: Shake the milk and soda water hard and fast to create the characteristic thick foam.
Pour the soda water slowly down the centre of the glass to build a substantial foam head.
Drink immediately whilst the foam is thick and the drink is cold.
storage: Consume immediately. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
